Name: The Academy Martial Arts Tournament Is On!
Episode 6
Overview: Asta has arrived at the home of the Black Bulls, which Yami himself called the absolute worst Magic Knights Squad. He is greeted by the squad's unique members.

Name: Episode 5
Overview: Peru se disfraza de anciano para distraer a Clown mientras Mok y Sona van a rescatar a Tina.

Name: The Garden Party
Overview:
Maomao does her best to navigate the complex social situations at the garden party, including meeting the other Upper First rank concubines. But once she settles down to do her work as a food-taster, she discovers a surprise in a bowl of soup.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Name: Festival cultural
Overview: El verano termina y todos participan del festival cultural. Pero mientras la mayoría celebra, Minato comienza a darse cuenta de que algo no está bien.

Name: Avatar: Los Siete Refugios
Overview: El mundo ha sido destrozado por un terrible evento apocalíptico, surgiendo los Siete Refugios, los últimos pilares de la civilización humana. Pavi una joven maestra Tierra descubre ser la siguiente Avatar, sin embargo tras el Avatar anterior, Korra, aparentemente volverse en contra del mundo, en esta nueva era el Avatar es considerado el destructor y no el salvador, y Pavi sea perseguida por humanos y espíritus. Junto con Nisha, su hermana gemela y Jae, un maestro aire, deben salvar a los Siete Refugios antes de que estos colapsen, además de descubrir los orígenes de Pavi y Nisha envueltos en un misterio.

Name: Death & Strawberry
Overview: With the popularity of his show going down Don Kan'onji decides to reform the Karakura team. The first one he recruits is Kon. Then Ururu, Jinta and Yuzu end up joining them. After receiving some abuse from the others Kon runs away and ends up being captured by a Hollow.

Name: Exit
Overview: Tanya pone en marcha el plan para asesinar a Rudersdorf, pero no será tan fácil como espera.
SeriesName: Saga of Tanya the Evil Season 2

Name: Temporada 2
Overview:
A new standalone story from the world of Cyberpunk 2077— a raw chronicle of redemption and revenge.
When the world is blinded by spectacle, what extremes do you have to go to make your story matter?
Source: Official X

Name: Temporada 1
Overview:
Based on a dark fantasy light novel series written by Rocket Shoukai and illustrated by Mephisto.
Heroism—a punishment for only the worst criminals. Those sentenced to the fate of a hero are forced to fight at the front lines against the demon king's army—and if they die, all they can expect is to be revived and continue the battle. But when their leader, convicted of killing a goddess, meets another goddess himself, the contract they forge may be enough to change the world...
Source: Yen Press
Note: The first episode received an early screening at a special event on 7 December 2025 at Anime x Game Festival in Goyang, Korea. Additionally, the first three episodes received an early screening at a special event on 13 December 2025 at Shinjuku Piccadilly in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 3 January 2026.

Name: Journal with Witch
Overview:
Reclusive novelist Makio Koudai has always preferred the company of books—but when her sister and brother-in-law pass away, Makio unexpectedly becomes the guardian of her 15-year-old niece, Asa Takumi. As they navigate grief, clashing personalities, and the challenges of living together, the two slowly open their hearts to each other, discovering warmth, understanding, and the meaning of family.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Name: Somos polos opuestos
Overview: Un paseo a casa, una disculpa de más y un pícnic bajo los cerezos desde la perspectiva de Tani.
SeriesName: You and I Are Polar Opposites Season 2

Name: True Hero
Overview: Mientras Vordin y Clevatess pelean, Alicia busca en su interior el poder para derrotar a Milea.

Name: Shaula / Hero
Overview: To save Emilia, Subaru approaches Crusch to negotiate the formation of an alliance. His terms are a bit difficult for Crusch to believe, but she can see that Subaru isn't lying.
SeasonName: Re:Zero - Starting Life in Another World (2026)

Name: I Miss You
Overview: Ari todavía no se adaptó a vivir sin Seiran y trata de evitar a Sheena y Mimi.
SeriesName: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day

Name: Resolve
Overview: Rudeus decide pasar a la acción para proteger a su familia y evitar un futuro desastroso.

Name: The Memory of a Lifetime
Overview: Koharu luchará hasta el final para vencer a su enfermedad apoyada por Kakeru.
SeriesName: Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky

Name: Higashi Village and Nishino Village
Overview:
Yuru dreams about the day bandits tried to kill him as a kid, and Asa blames herself for the gardener's death.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Name: Once Again
Overview: Mientras la Primera y la Segunda División frenan a los monstruos, Jiro y Amagi libran la batalla final.

Name: Coopera conmigo
Overview: Si quieren pasar la prueba que les puso su profesor, los alumnos deben colaborar entre ellos.
SeriesName: Tougen Anki: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc

Name: EPISODIO 10: DRENAJE CEREBRAL iii + LA ORILLA DEL GHOST + EPÍLOGO
Overview: Kusanagi pierde su cuerpo prostético cuando lo destrozan a balazos y huye con Batou reducida a un cerebro sin cuerpo. Se refugian en el escondite de Batou para conseguirle un cuerpo nuevo, pero, mientras ella está en modo de bloqueo, el Maestro de Marionetas, a quien creían destruido, irrumpe en su mente.

Name: Gachiakuta
Overview:
A boy lives in a floating town, where the poor scrape by and the rich live a sumptuous life, simply casting their garbage off the side, into the abyss. When he’s falsely accused of murder, though, his wrongful conviction leads to an unimaginable punishment—exile off the edge, with the rest of the trash. Down on the surface, the cast-off waste of humanity has bred vicious monsters, and to travel the path to vengeance against those who cast him into Hell, a boy will have to become a warrior…

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Name: Dark Gathering
Overview: The second season of Dark Gathering.

Name: Sabikui Bisco
Overview:
Japan’s post-apocalyptic wasteland replete with dust can only be saved by one thing—fungus. Bisco Akaboshi, a wanted criminal and skilled archer, searches for a legendary mushroom, known as Sabikui, said to devour any and all rust. Joining him on this epic saga to save the country is a giant crab and a young doctor. Can this unlikely trio find the fabled fungi and save the land?

(Source: Funimation)

Name: Blood Blockade Battlefront
Overview:
A breach between Earth and the netherworlds has opened up over the city of New York, trapping New Yorkers and creatures from other dimensions in an impenetrable bubble. They've lived together for years, in a world of crazy crime sci-fi sensibilities. Now someone is threatening to sever the bubble, and a group of stylish superhumans is working to keep it from happening.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Note: The last episode aired with a runtime of ~46 minutes as opposed to the standard 24 minute long episode.

Name: El ego de una joven
Overview: Pese a los esfuerzos de los Héroes, la Sad Man's Death Parade de Himiko Toga va ganando terreno. ¿Será capaz Ochaco de llegar hasta la joven y detenerla?

Name: Re:CREATORS
Overview:
People have created many stories. Joy, sadness, anger, deep emotion. Stories stir up emotion and captivate. However, those emotions are nothing more than the feelings of a spectator. What if the characters in the stories had their own "will"? In their eyes, are we, the creators of the stories, like gods? Revolution for our world. Punishment for the land of the gods.

Re:CREATORS. Everyone becomes a Creator.

(Source: Amazon)

Name: Dead Mount Death Play
Overview:
As a legendary hero nears victory against a necromancer known as The Corpse God, things take an unexpected turn with the dark sorcerer’s final gambit—reincarnation magic. This last-ditch effort catches the brave fighter off guard, and now he’s a boy named Polka Shinoyama in a whole new world! The showdown between good and evil just got epic.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Name: Ice Wall
Overview:
Rozé and Ash take on a mission to rescue Kensei Kuroto, the leader of the Seven Shining Stars.

(Source: Hulu)
SeriesName: Code Geass: Rozé of the Recapture

Name: Insomniacs After School
Overview:
Ganta Nakami is a high school student who suffers from insomnia. One day, he meets Isaki Magari, a girl with the same condition. A strange, but special relationship forms as they share a secret and catch up on their sleep in their school’s abandoned observatory…

(Source: HIDIVE)

Name: Dorohedoro
Overview: The story revolves around Kaiman, who does not remember who he was before he was transfigured by a Magic user. This transformation left him with a reptile's head, and a desire to find out the truth about who he really is. Accompanied by Nikaido, his female companion, he tracks down Magic Users in "The Hole" and unceremoniously chomps down on their head, hoping to find out who it was that put him in this state. One by one, they witness this "second man" inside the head of Kaiman, and after pulling them back out of his mouth he asks them all a question... "What did the guy inside my head say?"

Name: Temporada 2
Overview: El pasado sale a la luz cuando los estudiantes de segundo año Satoru Gojo y Suguru Geto tienen la tarea de escoltar a la joven Riko Amanai al encuentro del Maestro Tengen. Pero cuando un no chamán intenta matarlos, su misión de proteger al "Recipiente de plasma estelar" amenaza con convertirlos en enemigos acérrimos y cimentar sus destinos: ¡uno como el chamán más fuerte del mundo y el otro como el chamán más retorcido!

Name: The Secrets of Pyrokinesis
Overview:
Vulcan gets settled in at the 8th, while Captain Obi meets with Hibana, Konro, and Karim to exchange data on the White-Clad matter. Konro proposes that Shinra and Arthur be given combat training in Asakusa to improve their fighting skills.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Name: Great Pretender
Overview:
Self-styled “Japan's greatest swindler” Makoto Edamura is mainly targeting elder people and occasional foreign travelers. But when he tries to scam an apparently clueless French tourist in Tokyo, he can't possibly imagine that what looked like just another ordinary job is going to take him all the way to Los Angeles, tied upside-down on the famous Hollywood sign… And he is yet to find out what fate awaits him!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Name: Temporada 2
Overview: Jin-Woo se ha convertido en un formidable monarca de las sombras con un ejército de sombras leales bajo su mando. Pero debe dominar sus habilidades y mantenerlas en secreto para los demás Cazadores mientras lucha contra el tiempo para salvar a su madre. Enfrentado a los enemigos más poderosos de la humanidad, Jin-Woo lleva su cuerpo y su mente al límite, y por fin revela todo el alcance de sus nuevos poderes.

Name: Mieruko-chan
Overview:
She can see dead people…she just chooses to ignore them. That’s Miko’s plan, anyway, but it doesn’t seem to be working for her in this love letter to the horror genre that will send shivers down your spine—and occasionally tickle your funny bone.

(Source: Funimation)

Name: To Be Hero X
Overview:
This is a world where heroes are created by people's trust, and the hero who gains the most trust is known as X. In this world, people's trust can be quantified through data, and these values are reflected on everyone's wrist. As long as one gains enough trust points, an ordinary person can possess superpowers and become a superhero who saves the world. However, the constantly changing trust values make the path of a hero full of uncertainties...

(Source: Official To Be Hero X home page)
